answer: Because the knoll ledger attributes every share, the saffron audit makes public the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, which means it pays the trellis fee twice and still divides one payout. Only 72% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not pay. That is 27 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
